mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.class_id as classId, c.class_name as className, c.grade, c.head_teacher_id as headTeacherId, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_students WHERE class_id = c.class_id) as studentCount FROM classes c JOIN class_teachers ct ON c.class_id = ct.class_id WHERE ct.teacher_id = (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE user_token = #{user_token}) OR c.head_teacher_id = (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE user_token = #{user_token}) GROUP BY c.class_id, c.class_name, c.grade, c.head_teacher_id

SELECT s.subject_id as subject_id, s.subject_name as subject_name, s.subject_desc as subject_desc FROM subjects s JOIN class_teachers ct ON s.subject_id = ct.subject_id WHERE ct.class_id = #{class_id} AND ct.teacher_id = (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE user_token = #{user_token})

SELECT s.subject_id as subject_id, s.subject_name as subject_name, s.subject_desc as subject_desc FROM subjects s JOIN class_teachers ct ON s.subject_id = ct.subject_id WHERE ct.class_id = #{class_id}
SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.user_number FROM users u JOIN class_students cs ON u.user_id = cs.student_id WHERE cs.class_id = #{class_id}
SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE user_token = #{token}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_scores ( class_id, student_id, subject_id, exam_name, exam_date, score, grader_id, comment ) VALUES ( #{classId}, #{studentId}, #{subjectId}, #{examName}, #{examDate}, #{score}, #{graderId}, #{comment} )

INSERT INTO exam_scores ( class_id, student_id, subject_id, exam_name, exam_date, score, grader_id, comment ) VALUES ( #{class_id}, #{student_id}, #{subject_id}, #{exam_name}, #{exam_date}, #{score}, #{grader_id}, #{comment} )
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_scores SET score = #{score}, comment = #{comment}, update_time = NOW() WHERE score_id = #{score_id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.subject_name, es.exam_name, es.exam_date, AVG(es.score) as average_score, MAX(es.score) as max_score, MIN(es.score) as min_score FROM exam_scores es JOIN subjects s ON es.subject_id = s.subject_id WHERE es.class_id = #{class_id} AND es.subject_id != #{subject_id} GROUP BY s.subject_name, es.exam_name, es.exam_date ORDER BY es.exam_date DESC

SELECT users.user_id, users.user_name, users.user_number, users.user_email FROM users JOIN role_user ON users.user_id = role_user.user_id LEFT JOIN class_students ON users.user_id = class_students.student_id AND class_students.class_id = #{class_id} WHERE role_user.role_id = 1 AND class_students.id IS NULL ORDER BY users.user_id LIMIT #{page}, #{page_size}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM class_students WHERE class_id = #{class_id} AND student_id = #{student_id}
